name: visitor
title: Visitor (no session)
description: Someone opened the invite link and has not joined yet: JoinPrompt over a live table.

name: spectator
title: Spectator (joined, no seat)
description: Joined but not seated — watching a hand on the flop. Empty seats show “Sit”.

name: seated-waiting
title: Seated, waiting
description: In the hand on the flop; someone else is deciding.

name: my-turn-preflop
title: My turn — preflop
description: Hero in the big blind faces a raise and a call preflop (NLH). Countdown running.

name: my-turn-facing-bet
title: My turn — facing a bet (NLH)
description: Turn: Dev bets 60, Ari calls, hero to act with top pair.

name: my-turn-facing-bet-plo
title: My turn — facing a bet (PLO)
description: Pot-Limit Omaha flop: hero faces a pot bet; raise capped at pot.

name: allin-vote
title: All-in — run it vote
description: Hero all-in on the flop against Dev; Dev voted twice, hero has not voted yet.

name: runout-2-boards
title: Running it twice
description: Both voted twice: run 1 finished, run 2 mid-deal; equity shown under each player.

name: showdown-complete
title: Showdown complete
description: River showdown: Dev wins with a set, hero lost and may show; next-hand countdown.

name: fold-ending-runout-revealed
title: Fold ending — runout revealed
description: Everyone folded to Dev’s turn bet; hero revealed the cards that would have come.

name: away
title: Away
description: Hero is away; the table keeps playing without them.

name: busted
title: Busted
description: Hero lost their whole stack; the next hand runs without them. Request a buy-in.

name: host-with-requests
title: Host with pending requests
description: Hero is the host; a seat request and a rebuy are waiting for approval.

name: ledger-after-session
title: Ledger after a long session
description: 41 hands with rebuys, an adjustment and a cash-out; hero is the host (open the Ledger).

name: ended
title: Game ended
description: The host ended the game: everyone cashed out; read-only ledger and settle-up.

name: 9-handed
title: 9-handed
description: Full ring: nine players, bets out on the flop, one away, one folded.

name: heads-up
title: Heads-up
description: Two players; hero is on the button (small blind) and acts first preflop.

name: paused-between-hands
title: Paused
description: Host paused the game between hands; hero is seated.

name: away-hand-complete
title: Away — hand over
description: Hero went away mid-hand and was folded; the hand ended by fold. Hero can still show and reveal the runout.

name: spectator-fold-ending
title: Spectator — fold ending
description: Joined but not seated; the hand ended by fold and anyone may reveal the runout.

name: removed-by-host
title: Removed by the host (all-in)
description: Hero is all-in; the host removed them, so they are cashed out when the hand ends (no “Stay seated”).
